report.explanation: Payment shows elevated p95 (1600ms), erroring authorize spans, and 504 deadline-exceeded logs, while gateway/order/inventory remain healthy; this supports downstream latency at payment as the bounded root cause of checkout degradation. The slow dependency within payment is not yet identified.
